findings_and_relationships.observation: The authored 95e YAML has autoresolve guarded speed 2.0, lunge speed 5.5 and lunge maximum travel 1.0 alongside matching movement raised-guard, run and quickstep-target values. Core build source projects the movement values into those three fields of EMBEDDED_AUTORESOLVE_PARAMETERS, and resolve_battle reads that generated constant. The tactical config retains an AutoresolveParameters field and parent validation separately validates its members and movement members; the personally read full parent validate body does not compare these paired values.
findings_and_relationships.condition_and_limits: The committed literal pairs agree. If a supported authored configuration changes an autoresolve-side value without its movement-side counterpart, the inspected build projection remains derived from movement. A separate tactical-server runtime config is not proof that a separately built strategic process dynamically consumes it. Whether divergent custom inputs or independently tunable values are supported, deployed, observed or intended remains unresolved. No build, authored edit or battle executed.
